digest.component_or_area: review gates (code review and plan review discovery)
propositions: Code review and plan review currently use partially independent discovery paths that allow misalignment in built-in retunes, project criteria activation, applicability enforcement, and checkpoint decisions.
The unified discovery architecture must derive both gates from one immutable effective-policy snapshot while preserving each gate's independent scheduler, topology, and response contracts.
Project code-review LLM criteria require non-empty repository-relative glob lists; empty-list semantics must migrate to explicit `["**"]` for repository-wide coverage without behavioral change.

The shared discovery executor owns typed outcomes, budget enforcement, and success-only checkpoint mechanics; gate-owned strategies retain context and topology decisions while verdict policy remains gate-independent.
The `rebar review-plan --retry` command must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing calls with fresh budget, and refuse stale lineages before any model call.
The workflow editor must separate editable Authored Workflow from read-only Effective Policy while rejecting empty project code-review LLM glob lists.
